title.narrative: The Road to Europe Program for Accounting and Institutional Strengthening (REPARIS) Multi Donor Trust Fund for Regional Programs

description.narrative:
"The proposed REPARIS MDTF will support implementation of the regional REPARIS Program under the overall Road to Europe Program for Accounting Reform and Institutional Strengthening (REPARIS). Specifically, the MDTF will assist the countries to develop common solutions to shared challenges in implementation of financial reporting reforms, recognizing that counties of the South Central and South East Europe (REPARIS countries) have similar legal and economic backgrounds, that they all wish to converge on EU practices and that are unable to address several important issues alone.
The regional REPARIS Program is designed to allow the REPARIS countries to tackle issues shared regionally, to promote cooperation among them, to ensure coordinated actions within a common framework, while the countries themselves focus on implementation of financial reporting reforms at the national level, set out in their respective country action plans (CAPs).
The REPARIS Program seeks to (i) help the REPARIS countries establish strong institutional and regulatory frameworks necessary for increased transparency, for effective functioning of the internal market and for mitigation of the risk of financial system crises, and (ii) assist with institutional, regulatory and accounting capacity development, alongside EU, other development partners, and private and public sector stakeholders to improve the business environment and investment climate and to facilitate their integration into EU."
